tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250ye shes rab 'bar las: sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog dbang don bsdus bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ye shes rab 'bar las: sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog dbang ni: ྈ dbang drag he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo:

ye shes rab 'bar sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i brgyud 'dzin snying ltar gces pa'i slob ma re re tsam la: sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog dbang bskur na: sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba bzlas pa dang bcas pa grub nas: maṇḍal gsol ba 'debs pa ni: oṃ: he ru ka dpal che ba'i mchog: ā: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: hūm̐: rig rtsal 'gran pa'i zla med kyis: sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog snying gi: nus pa rtag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang: che mchog he ru ka yis stsol: zhes pa la slob dpon gyis: e ma nyon cig rigs kyi bu: mi srun drag rtsal sde brgyad kyi: srog gi dwangs ma'i thig le che: padma drag po'i dbang du 'dus: rdo rje 'dzin pas dbang sbyin gyis: sgrub pa'i nus pa ston cig bu: zhes gsur chen dang rol mo gnad bskul sogs bya: slob ma drag po'i nga rgyal ma yengs par gsal thebs pa gal che: bskur ba ni: a gtad la: hūm̐: tshangs pa dkar po la sogs pa'i: lha chen rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog gi yi ge a la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: lha yi sde rigs srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: ya gtad la: hūm̐: ya ma rā tsa la sogs pa'i: gshin rje'i rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog snying yi ge ya la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: gshin rje'i sde rigs srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: ma gtad la: hūm̐: e ka tsā ti la sogs pa'i: ma mo rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog snying yi ge ma la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: ma mo'i sde rigs srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: du gtad la: hūm̐: bdud rje nag po la sogs pa'i: bdud kyi rigs 'dus srung ma yis: srog snying yi ge du la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis:

bdud kyi rigs 'dus srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: ru gtad la: hūm̐: yam shud dmar po la sogs pa'i: btsan gyi rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog snying yi ge ru la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: btsan gyi rigs 'dus srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: tsa gtad la: hūm̐: khyab 'jug chen po la sogs pa'i: gza' yi rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog snying yi ge tsa la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: gza' yi sde rigs srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: sha gtad la: hūm̐: gnod sbyin yaksha nag po sogs: gnod sbyin rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog snying yi ge sha la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: gnod sbyin sde rigs srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: na gtad la: hūm̐: klu bdud nag po la sogs pa'i: klu yi rigs 'dus yongs rdzogs kyi: srog snying yi ge na la 'dus: sgrub mchog 'di la gtad pa yis: klu yi sde rigs srung ma yis: 'bangs su bran dang yang g.yog gyis: gnyen po sgrub pa yun ma thung: ces bskur: dam bsre gnyer gtad bka' gtad dam tshig gi gnyer gtad ni: e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu: 'jig rten dregs pa bran bzhin du: slob dpon lung gis bskur phyin chad: deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis: gnyen po sgrub pa'i rgya ma klod: 'jig rten dregs pa bran khol la: mchod dang gtor ma rgyun ma gcod: dam tshig tshul la gnas par gces: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: drag po gsum dang srog bdag gsum gyis srungs shig: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rgya rgya rgya: sa ma ya rgya: zhes bde chen brag dkar zla gam dbang gi da la nas/ ye shes mkha' 'gros spyan 'dren zhing sprad pa ste/

rgya chen bka'i bsdu ba yid la gces pa'i grogs po/ mkha' spyod kyis bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ klong yangs rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa klong gsal snying pos rang bzhin lha'i skyed mos tshal nas dag par phab pa'o// 'di'i lag len/ gzhi mdun lta bur zhing gi gdan la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad rkang gsum steng thod pa'i nang bla rdo'am srog yig brgyad bcug /rtsibs brgyad la dmar gtor brgyad bkod/ liṅga sgrol gri 'du bya/ drag po'i dbang bskur grub rjes/ 1$0000250hūm̐: deng gi gnas mchog 1$0000300 sogs nas/ 1$0000250myur du sgrolaḥ 1$0000300 bar/ nya'o mdun du bkod la 'gugs gzhug gsum/ 1$0000250hūm̐: che mchog padma1$0000300 sa bsgral/ 1$0000250oṃ āḥhūm̐ 1$0000300 sogs nas 1$0000250khā hi1$0000300 'i bar gyis bstab/ bka' gtad nang*/ 1$0000250oṃ: he ru ka dpal 1$0000300 nas/ 1$0000250ston cig bu 1$0000300 bar gyis gsol gdab gnang sbyin bya/ 1$0000250hūm̐: nga ni padma 1$0000300 sogs nas/ 1$0000250rakṣa badzra sa ma ya: 1$0000300 bar gyis ling ro slob mar sbyin/ 1$0000250hūm̐: tshangs pa dkar po 1$0000300 sogs nas 1$0000250gnas par gces: 1$0000300 bar tshang ba brjod la bla rdo srog yig so sor gtad/ re re bzhin 'bru gsum dang*/ 1$0000250oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā:1$0000300 sogs kyis gtor ma 'bul la phyi rol mchod/ mthar tshogs mchod bya/ 1$0000250de ltar sde brgyad dregs pa'i srog dbang bskur ba 1$0000300 sogs brjod pas 'grub bo/// /
